Axiomatter.verbatim_definition: Physical manifestation of pure indisputable truth where raw strength is not measured merely in weight but in the sovereign reality of the action itself.
Axiomatter.prohibited_usage: Cannot be used as a numerical tier (e.g. Level 5 Axiomatter) or as a linear tier above/below Transboundless.
Axiomatter.canon_normalization: Canonical term established. Represents objective truth taking concrete physical form.

Hyperverity.verbatim_definition: A classification for narrative statements where a spoken absolute truth forcefully and permanently overwrites the existing mechanical logic of the entire universe.
Hyperverity.prohibited_usage: Cannot be treated as an Attack Potency (AP) or Durability rating. Spoken truth overwriting mechanics != quantitative Joules.
Hyperverity.canon_normalization: Canonical term established. Represents predicate authority overwriting cosmic mechanics.

Transboundless.verbatim_definition: A state of capacity and volume that instantly outgrows any conceptual container or logical boundary the exact microsecond someone tries to measure it.
Transboundless.formal_syntax: Transboundless(X) => ForAll B in Bounds(X): Measure(X, B) -> X > B
Transboundless.prohibited_usage: Cannot be simplified to standard mathematical infinity. Does not automatically imply inaccessible major terms without proof of universal closure bounds.
Transboundless.canon_normalization: Canonical term established. Describes capacity that exceeds observation boundaries dynamically.

Nullinfinity_vs_Nullfinity.verbatim_definition: A mathematical and conceptual measurement describing a power gap so enormous that standard maximum limits and impossibilities are reduced to absolute zero relative to the gap.
Nullinfinity_vs_Nullfinity.prohibited_usage: Strictly prohibited as a standalone tier (e.g. Character is Nullinfinity). Must always explicitly define both Scale A and Scale B.
Nullinfinity_vs_Nullfinity.canon_normalization: Spelling alias noted. Site architecture must support both search terms while pending primary author normalization.

Omniprecedent.verbatim_definition: A supreme scaling metric where an Arthitean does not merely break a universal rule but retroactively becomes the fundamental reason the rule was ever created.
Omniprecedent.prohibited_usage: Cannot be used without specifying the target rule R (e.g. Omniprecedent durability is invalid without identifying what durability constraint rule is superseded).
Omniprecedent.canon_normalization: Canonical term established. Retroactive teleological origin of governing universal constraints.
